name: qfx-wow-addon-ui-plugin
description: Reusable Codex skill for designing and refactoring World of Warcraft addon UIs and architectures with Blizzard-native controls, compact multilingual layout, modular architecture, Plater/DandersFrames-inspired deep reference patterns, controlled extension hooks, adapter/resolver/renderer pipelines, capability gates, self-healing media fallback, object pool reset discipline, post-load validation, category-scoped import/export, auto-profile switching, safe profilers, diagnostics, packaging checks, performance, and taint-safety checks.

interface.shortDescription: Blizzard-native WoW addon UI and architecture workflow
interface.longDescription: Guides Codex to design, review, and refactor World of Warcraft addon interfaces and architectures using native Blizzard-style controls, compact multilingual layout, modular UI factory rules, safe media fallback, SavedVariables migration, event/OnUpdate discipline, Plater-inspired option pages, DandersFrames-inspired complex settings patterns, deep reference-addon patterns, controlled extension hooks, adapter/resolver/renderer pipelines, capability gates, object pool reset rules, post-load validation, category-scoped import/export, auto-profile switching, safe profilers, diagnostics, release packaging checks, and Retail 12.x secret-value/taint safety.
defaultPrompt: Use QFX WoW Addon UI to refactor this add-on settings panel into a Blizzard-native unified layout using the existing UI factory.

Use QFX WoW Addon UI to redesign this addon architecture using reference-addon patterns from Plater and DandersFrames: deterministic TOC order, root namespace, lifecycle phases, module registry, DB/profile migration, targeted event dispatchers, import/export validation, public API boundary, and lazy diagnostics.

Use QFX WoW Addon UI to do a deep architecture pass using Plater and DandersFrames patterns: controlled extension hooks, adapter/resolver/renderer pipeline, capability gates, self-healing media fallback, object pool reset, post-load validation, category import/export, auto-profile switching, safe profiler, and alert state machines.

Use QFX WoW Addon UI to apply Plater-style options design: tabbed categories, table-driven option rows, reusable templates, delayed creation of heavy pages, searchable settings, and one global refresh callback.

Use QFX WoW Addon UI to apply DandersFrames-style complex settings design: persistent collapsible groups, semantic banners, See Also navigation, searchable settings registry, guided setup wizard, profile override indicators, preview-safe editors, and lazy diagnostics.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to compact this settings page, account for English/zhCN/zhTW label length, and fully use the available template width without overflow.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to remove duplicate controls with the same effective function unless their scopes are clearly different.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to review this WoW add-on UI for layout drift, architecture drift, custom controls, localization gaps, taint risk, performance problems, and packaging completeness.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to fix this saved voice collection UI: selection, drag-out behavior, long sound picker, TTS test path, and large-list refresh performance.
Use QFX WoW Addon UI to prepare release notes and a package checklist for this QFX add-on.
